about_short_description.short_description: Blockscout is a powerful open-source blockchain explorer and analytics platform.

product.name: Blockscout Multichain Block Explorer
product.description: An open-source block explorer that enables searching, tracking, and analyzing blockchain data across multiple EVM-based networks in a unified interface.

product.name: Smart Contract Verification and Interaction
product.description: Provides tools for verifying, publishing, reading, writing, and interacting with smart contracts and proxies on EVM-based blockchains.

product.name: DAppscout - Decentralized Application Marketplace
product.description: An integrated marketplace within Blockscout for discovering, exploring, and interacting with decentralized applications across multiple blockchain networks.

product.name: APIs and Developer Tools
product.description: Offers REST and JSON RPC APIs, tagging, debuggers, and other developer tools to access blockchain data and interact with smart contracts.

identifier.value: Network Statistics and Gas Fee Tracking

product.name: Network Statistics and Gas Fee Tracking
product.description: Displays real-time network statistics including gas fees and granular blockchain trends to inform onchain decisions.
